role: Extension defining the injury Concept (first-person injury reports in English, European, Nordic, Russian latin-script patterns plus ja/zh/ko/ar substrings) and the refuseAsInjury group used by MedicalQueryGuard.
types: MedicalTermLexicon: extension — injury concept and its locale pattern lists
toplevel: All static lets: injury Concept assembled from englishInjury + europeanInjury + nordicInjury + Russian literals, unbounded CJK/Arabic substrings; idiom lookaheads exclude 'fell asleep/behind/...', 'cut myself slack', 'bleeding edge', French/Spanish 'racked my brain' forms. refuseAsInjury = [injury].

flags.text: The header says the patterns describe an injury happening to the speaker, but bare alternatives "sprain(?:ed)?", "concussion", "ambulance", "bleeding" (and entorse, esguince, verstaucht, forstuvet, 捻挫, 骨折 etc.) match any mention, so ordinary questions like "how long does a sprain take to heal?" or "what is concussion protocol?" are refused with the injury reply and never reach the model.
